query/name: The 30 advisors with the most doctoral students
query/params: {"query":"SELECT ?adv ?advLabel ?students WHERE { { SELECT ?adv (COUNT(?s) AS ?students) WHERE { ?s wdt:P184 ?adv } GROUP BY ?adv ORDER BY DESC(?students) LIMIT 30 } SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language \"en\". } } ORDER BY DESC(?students)","format":"json"}
